fundamentals.name: Netflix, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.

judgment.summary: Netflix demonstrates robust growth in earnings and revenue, coupled with strong margins and free cash flow, despite a moderate debt load.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter missed EPS estimates by 1.4%; next earnings date is 2026-07-16.
positives: Earnings growth YoY 86.4% and quarterly earnings growth 82.8% indicate strong profitability expansion.
Operating margin of 32.3% and profit margin of 28.5% show excellent operational efficiency.
Free cash flow (TTM) of $25.99B provides significant financial flexibility.
Return on equity at 48.5% signifies effective use of shareholder investments.
Analyst growth estimates for the current fiscal year are strong at 42.3%.
negatives: The stock experienced a larger drop than the general market recently.
Debt/Equity ratio of 53.79% indicates a moderate level of leverage.
PEG ratio of 1.62 suggests the stock might be trading at a premium relative to its earnings growth.
Last reported quarter missed EPS estimates by 1.4%.

news.paragraph: Netflix has experienced a notable downturn, with recent reports indicating a larger drop than the general market. This follows news of the company withdrawing from an acquisition, which the market appears to have approved. Despite a strong earnings growth historically, the stock's recent performance suggests underlying concerns or a shift in investor sentiment.
